spec_match.rationale: The rule under test is the spec's URL-parser-based 'contains a javascript: URL' check across the built-in navigating URL attributes, MathML href, and SVG a href — exactly the lists PR 12898's inner sanitize steps consult.

interactive.rationale: One button runs 56 real sanitizer calls (8 spellings × 7 attribute targets) and paints a per-cell kept/stripped/elem-gone matrix; nothing is precomputed.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promises obfuscated spellings crossed with every navigation attribute including the deliberately-untouched ones; the matrix delivers that.

edge_cases.rationale: Case-mangling, leading spaces, tab-split scheme, entity encoding, and the negative controls (vbscript:, data:, https:) are all rows; the safe-path fallback explains allowlist-caused removals separately from the javascript:-URL rule.

conformance.rationale: The matrix's unsafe-strict call is the same contract as the suite's unsafe-optin-strips-with-sanitizer-proof assertion, generalised across spellings and attributes.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (Playwright CDP): Run clicked at 1280×800 and 360×740; the real TypeError (probe.setHTML is not a function) surfaced in the verdict and the labelled spec summary was shown; zero console errors / failed requests; 0px horizontal overflow both classes; screenshots read. DOWNGRADED pass→partial (review finding, 2026-10-18): Chromium 141 lacks the Sanitizer API, so only the fallback/exception branch executed — the supported-path primary interaction (real sanitization output on a Sanitizer-enabled build) remains unverified, and fallback-only verification is partial by this rubric’s own standard. Re-run on Chrome 146+/157 to upgrade.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts sanitizer-jsurls-matrix-ran with cells/unexpected counts on real runs and sanitizer-jsurls-matrix-absent tied to the real exception on the fallback.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; legend and cells use accent-emerald-dark/accent-rose on paper for AA; matrix scrolls inside a bordered wrapper.

accessibility.rationale: Matrix has caption, row/column th scopes, a keyboard-focusable scroll region, a text legend duplicating the colour coding, and an aria-live verdict.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes verified: the wide matrix scrolls horizontally inside its wrapper without page overflow (0px document overflow at 360px).

openQuestions.title: Record the real matrix outcomes on a 157 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 only the fallback branch runs. On a Chrome 157 binary, run the matrix in unsafe-strict mode and record which cells read stripped vs elem-gone (e.g. whether area/form survive the unsafe defaults), and verify the five javascript-scheme rows strip in all seven targets including math href.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive form control panel layout without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep proper header semantics and let wide tables scroll in a labelled region rather than overflowing the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Matrix uses caption + scoped th for rows and columns inside a tabindex=0 region with role=region; page-level overflow measured 0px at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: sanitize untrusted HTML safely setHTML Sanitizer API
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Never treat an ignored unknown dictionary member as support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The unsafe-strict mode is only selected after an element-allowlist side effect proves setHTMLUnsafe honours sanitizer configs.

guidanceConsulted.query: colour coded status cells accessible text equivalent
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair colour with text so state is not colour-only.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every cell carries the literal words kept/stripped/elem gone; the legend repeats them.

summary: A 56-cell live matrix of obfuscated javascript:-URL spellings against the spec's navigation-attribute lists, isolating the new option on the unsafe path, with negative controls showing what the rule deliberately ignores. On Chromium 141 the honest fallback branch and labelled spec summary were verified at both viewport classes.
